# Temporary Directory

![Temporary Directory function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/path/10-constante-chemin.svg)

[Path functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Context constant returning the existing temporary directory supplied by the current execution environment through its system service. It does not create a file or a fresh subdirectory. Failure to obtain a valid directory reports an explicit diagnostic.
